fullPassage: Generation Z (Gen Z) is made up of people born between 1997 and 2012. They are often called "digital natives" because they grew up using the internet. They are now beginning to enter the workforce, so understanding their unique expectations is important for employers. Gen Z prioritizes work flexibility over salary, so they request control over their work schedule. To find a balance between their work and personal lives is also important to them, so they seek jobs that enable them to fulfill both their personal and professional goals. Companies turning a blind eye to these preferences will find it challenging to recruit Gen Z workers. It is necessary to offer them work environments that match their values.

questions.passage: Generation Z (Gen Z) is made up of people born between 1997 and 2012. They are often called "digital natives" because they grew up using the internet. They are now beginning to enter the workforce, so understanding their unique expectations is important for employers. Gen Z prioritizes work (A)[flexibility / rigidity] over salary, so they request control over their work schedule. To find a balance between their work and personal lives is also important to them, so they seek jobs that (B)[enable / disable] them to fulfill both their personal and professional goals. Companies turning a blind eye to these preferences will find it (C)[challenging / easy] to recruit Gen Z workers. It is necessary to offer them work environments that match their values.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) flexibility=유연성 / rigidity=경직성 (B) enable=가능하게 하다 / disable=불가능하게 하다 (C) challenging=어려운 / easy=쉬운
det.analysis:
① flexibility—enable—challenging: Z세대는 유연성을 우선시하고, 직업은 목표 달성을 가능하게 해야 하며, 선호를 무시하면 채용이 어려워진다 ←정답
② rigidity: 경직성은 문맥과 반대
③ disable/easy: 불가능하게 하다/쉬운은 문맥과 반대
④ rigidity/disable: 경직성/불가능은 문맥과 반대
det.tip: Z세대가 원하는 것(flexibility)과 기업이 직면하는 어려움(challenging)의 흐름

questions.passage: Generation Z (Gen Z) is made up of people born between 1997 and 2012. They are often called "digital natives" because they grew up using the internet. They are now beginning to enter the workforce, so understanding their (A)[unique / ordinary] expectations is important for employers. Gen Z prioritizes work flexibility over salary, so they request control over their work schedule. To find a (B)[balance / conflict] between their work and personal lives is also important to them, so they seek jobs that enable them to fulfill both their personal and professional goals. Companies turning a blind eye to these preferences will find it challenging to recruit Gen Z workers. It is (C)[necessary / optional] to offer them work environments that match their values.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) unique=독특한 / ordinary=평범한 (B) balance=균형 / conflict=갈등 (C) necessary=필수적인 / optional=선택적인
det.analysis:
① ordinary—balance—necessary: (A) 기대는 ordinary가 아닌 unique
② unique—conflict—optional: (B)(C) 균형을 찾고 제공이 필수적임
③ unique—balance—necessary: 독특한 기대 + 균형 + 필수적 제공 ←정답
④ ordinary—conflict—optional: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: Z세대의 기대가 unique하고, 일과 삶의 balance를 원하며, 환경 제공이 necessary하다는 흐름

questions.passage: Generation Z (Gen Z) is made up of people born between 1997 and 2012. They are often called "digital natives" because they grew up using the internet. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) prioritizes=우선시하다 / neglects=무시하다 (B) fulfill=이행하다 / abandon=포기하다 (C) recruit=채용하다 / dismiss=해고하다
det.analysis:
① neglects—fulfill—recruit: (A) Z세대는 유연성을 neglect하지 않고 prioritize함
② prioritizes—fulfill—recruit: 유연성 우선 + 목표 이행 + 채용 어려움 ←정답
③ prioritizes—abandon—dismiss: (B)(C) abandon/dismiss는 문맥과 반대
④ neglects—abandon—recruit: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: Z세대의 적극적 태도(prioritizes, fulfill)와 기업의 채용 어려움(recruit) 흐름

det.korean: ③ natives=원어민 ② important=중요한 ③ enable→prevent (부적절) ④ preferences=선호

questions.passage: Generation Z (Gen Z) is made up of people born between 1997 and 2012. They are often called "digital natives" because they grew up using the internet. They are now beginning to enter the workforce, so understanding their unique expectations is important for employers. Gen Z prioritizes work flexibility over salary, so they request control over their work schedule. To find a balance between their work and personal lives is also important to them, so they seek jobs that enable them to fulfill both their personal and professional goals. Companies turning a blind eye to these preferences will find it challenging to recruit Gen Z workers. It is necessary to offer them __________ that match their values.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: work flexibility=업무 유연성 / personal lives=개인 생활 / professional goals=직업적 목표 / work environments=업무 환경
det.analysis:
① work flexibility: 가치에 맞는 업무 유연성을 제공? 유연성은 환경의 일부이지 제공 대상이 아님
② personal lives: 가치에 맞는 개인 생활을 제공? 기업이 제공할 수 없음
③ professional goals: 가치에 맞는 직업적 목표를 제공? 목표는 개인이 설정
④ work environments: 가치에 맞는 업무 환경을 제공하는 것이 필요 ←정답
det.tip: offer + that match their values → 기업이 제공할 수 있는 것 = work environments

questions.passage: Generation Z (Gen Z) is made up of people born between 1997 and 2012. They are often called "__________" because they grew up using the internet. They are now beginning to enter the workforce, so understanding their unique expectations is important for employers. Gen Z prioritizes work flexibility over salary, so they request control over their work schedule. To find a balance between their work and personal lives is also important to them, so they seek jobs that enable them to fulfill both their personal and professional goals. Companies turning a blind eye to these preferences will find it challenging to recruit Gen Z workers. It is necessary to offer them work environments that match their values.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: digital natives=디지털 원어민 / Gen Z workers=Z세대 근로자 / personal lives=개인 생활 / professional goals=직업적 목표
det.analysis:
① digital natives: 인터넷을 사용하며 자란 세대이므로 '디지털 원어민'으로 불린다 ←정답
② Gen Z workers: Z세대 근로자로 불린다? 뒤 문맥의 because(인터넷 사용)와 연결 안 됨
③ personal lives: 개인 생활로 불린다? 문맥 부적절
④ professional goals: 직업적 목표로 불린다? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: because they grew up using the internet(인터넷을 사용하며 자랐기 때문에) → digital natives
